newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai television set output plunges in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai television set output plunges in 1996.

text.p: The output of colour television sets in Shanghai plunged by a year-on-year 61.9 percent to 426,000 sets in 1996 because the local product could not compete with sets made elsewhere, the Business News said on Tuesday.
The fall was estimated to have caused a loss of 1.35 billion yuan in sales income for the city in 1996, the newspaper, quoting the Shanghai Statistics Bureau, said.
The national market share for Shanghai's once-famous Jinxing Brand had dropped to 2.6 percent according to a survey last November, it said.
The trend was also reflected in Shanghai-produced refrigerators, washing machines and microwave ovens, it said.
"There has been no change in the trend of Shanghai lagging behind other regions in producing electrical appliances in recent years," the newspaper said.
"Its electrical appliances industry is trapped in its lack of competitiveness," it added, but gave no further details.
